notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
in this update, there have been replacements to some sounds and now you can change the key bindings in the options menu.
Please note that this WILL require a reset of your save file, this is not compatible with old saves.
Thanks all and continue to enjoy this great game!
